summary: Checked all 222 estimates against their cited PDF pages and reviewed the complete markdown conversion, including Appendices A-G. Confirmed the printed statistics, analysis-specific people counts, arm attribution, and codebook fields. An independent check of 1,651 values against PDF table rows and columns found no mismatches. No eligible outcome or contrast was missing. The conflicting broadness p-value and Table G.2 difference-column heading are already documented correctly; unavailable values and reduced-sample arm counts remain null.
